[[Chehbaba's Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Chehbaba Roottripper]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mount Qinkai]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[physical damage]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Wooden Longbow]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Longbow (wooden)|Longbow]] from crafters [[Mathilde]] or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Shelter]]
*Black [[dye]]


Except for the [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*[[Wooden Longbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Shelter]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|To the Pain]]" inscription
*Black [[dye]]
